svg.aria-label: Lat pulldown, Reach: Set your thighs under the pad, lean back slightly, and reach up with long arms.
svg.title: Lat pulldown, Reach: Set your thighs under the pad, lean back slightly, and reach up with long arms.

svg.aria-label: Lat pulldown, Pull: Drive your elbows down as you bring the bar toward your chest.
svg.title: Lat pulldown, Pull: Drive your elbows down as you bring the bar toward your chest.

svg.aria-label: Lat pulldown, Chest: Bring the bar to your upper chest while keeping your thighs under the pad.
svg.title: Lat pulldown, Chest: Bring the bar to your upper chest while keeping your thighs under the pad.

svg.aria-label: Lat pulldown, Return: Let the bar rise under control until your arms are long again.
svg.title: Lat pulldown, Return: Let the bar rise under control until your arms are long again.
